scope: Four copied upstream puzzle implementations adapted locally; upstream originals retained outside the build. No remote installer or repository script executed.

games.copiedRules: html5games.matchgame.js: deck setup, card selection, comparison and matching logic. jquery-1.6.min.js is copied byte-for-byte with its original MIT/GPL alternative notice; MIT-LICENSE from jquery/jquery tag 1.6 is included.
games.changes: Native button cards, newly drawn typographic symbols, responsive grid, removal completion without WebKit-only events, 120-second deadline and shared victory/pause bridge. Original gameover/save/load storage bodies removed; originals retained in docs. No card sprite, external font, remote URL or extra storage copied into the running game.
games.controls: Mouse click, touch, Tab and Enter on card buttons.
games.victory: All six actual card pairs matched and removed.
games.assets: No upstream image or font used; glyphs and CSS are local. jQuery 1.6 license text sourced from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jquery/jquery/1.6/MIT-LICENSE.txt.

games.copiedRules: grid.js, tile.js, keyboard_input_manager.js, html_actuator.js and game_manager.js copied; original slide/merge, collision, random tile creation and game-over rules remain active.
games.changes: Target is explicitly 256 for a short album challenge, instead of upstream 2048. Local ink CSS/HTML, touch direction buttons, Portuguese result, in-memory session storage and shared progress/pause bridge. Upstream fonts, images, analytics and persistent storage module not served.
games.victory: A legal merge creates a tile of value 256; track15 editorial title remains pending.
games.assets: No upstream image or font used.
